title: How Much Can Reliability Drift Under a Fixed Confidence Distribution?
abstract: arXiv:2609.38917v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A classifier's conditional accuracy can change while its confidence distribution stays exactly the same. We study the worst-case movement of the reliability relation under covariate shifts that preserve the distribution of the confidence score, constraining the reweighting within each confidence level by a $\chi^2$ budget; the resulting worst case, as a function of the budget, is a fragility profile. On an interval of budgets that can be computed from the source distribution, the profile equals exactly the square root of the budget times the within-level variance of the correctness propensity -- the grouping-loss term of calibration-refinement decompositions. Beyond this interval the profile is governed by the tails of the propensity law, and the entire upward profile determines the centred within-level law; consequently, calibration residual and grouping variance do not determine fragility in general, though they do when labels and pred

translated_title: 在固定置信度分布下，可靠性最多能漂移多少？
translated_abstract: 分类器的条件准确率可以在其置信度分布完全保持不变的情况下发生变化。我们研究了在保持置信度分数分布不变的协变量偏移下，可靠性关系的最坏情况变化，其中每个置信度水平内的重加权受到一个 χ² 预算的约束；由此得到的最坏情况作为预算的函数，构成一条“脆弱性轮廓”。在一个可由源分布计算出的预算区间上，该轮廓恰好等于预算的平方根乘以正确性倾向的水平内方差——即校准-细化分解中的分组损失项。超出该区间后，轮廓由倾向律的尾部决定，且整条上升轮廓决定了中心化的水平内律；因此，一般而言校准残差与分组方差并不能决定脆弱性，尽管当标签与预（测……）（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出用 χ² 预算约束的“脆弱性轮廓”来刻画置信度分布保持不变的协变量偏移下分类器可靠性的最坏漂移，并证明在可计算的预算区间内该轮廓恰为预算平方根乘以正确性倾向的水平内方差（即分组损失项），从而表明校准残差与分组方差一般不足以决定模型的脆弱性。
